release_name: Coordinates: Beatitudes located, 6 sites upgraded from locality level
notes: Coordinate work using Google Maps place markers, each accepted only through two gates: the search must resolve to an actual named place (a title equal to the search query means nothing was found, and the coordinates are only the map viewport), and the pin must fall within 4 km of the site existing locality coordinate. Beatitudes (Bati, Grand-Gaube) had NO coordinate at all and is now located at the Google place marker for La chapelle beatitude on Route Royale. Six sites moved from locality_level to exact_site_approx: Notre-Dame-du-Bon-Conseil (Moka), L Eau Vive (Chebel), Sacre-Coeur (Glen-Park), Notre-Dame-de-Lourdes (Curepipe), Sainte-Famille (Dubreuil) and Bon-Pasteur (Elizabethville). Two candidates were REJECTED by the gates and deliberately left alone: Sainte-Famille (Henrietta), where Google resolved no place despite the coordinates looking plausible at 2.66 km, and Notre-Dame-de-la-Confiance (Barkly), where Google returned a differently-named church 15 km away. Notre-Dame-du-Grand-Pouvoir (Cap Malheureux) remains the only site with no coordinate: Google has no record of it, and the single same-named result is 32.7 km away at neither of the two Grand-Pouvoir sites in the data, so it was not accepted. 39 sites remain at locality level. No schedule data changed: 424 rows.
